description: React component for managing and displaying a list of users to remove in the Mattermost admin console, including pagination, filtering, and loading user memberships.

classes.name: UsersToRemove
classes.description: React component class for displaying and managing a list of users to remove, with pagination, filtering, and data loading.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state with page 0 and loading true.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Preloads user memberships in parallel after component mounts.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Resets modal search term and filters on unmount.

methods.name: loadMembersForProfilesList
methods.description: Loads channel or team members based on scope.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Navigates to the previous page of users.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Navigates to the next page of users.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Sets search term and resets to first page.

methods.name: onFilter
methods.description: Applies role and scope filters to user list.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Generates data grid rows for current page.

methods.name: getFilterOptions
methods.description: Builds filter options based on scope and guest account settings.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the data grid with users, filters, and pagination controls.
